command:
systemctl cat init_display.service; systemctl show init_display.service -p ExecStart -p FragmentPath; journalctl -b -u init_display.service --no-pager -n 90; printf '
WESTON FILES
'; for p in $(pidof weston); do printf 'PID %s CWD ' "$p"; readlink /proc/$p/cwd; ls -l /proc/$p/fd/ | head -n 45; done; printf '
WAYLAND OUTPUTS
'; if command -v weston-info >/dev/null; then timeout 10 env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/root WAYLAND_DISPLAY=wayland-0 weston-info 2>&1 | head -n 95; fi
